reasoning: Nevada’s statewide Cook PVI is approximately EVEN/D+1, commonly cited as R+1 or D+1 depending on the rounding convention; I used D+1 as a single-point Democratic lean. In the last 45 days, the only directly relevant Nevada general-election polling result surfaced here is an aggregate showing Jacky Rosen (D) up 46% to Sam Brown (R) 47%, which is a Brown +1 edge and therefore a Republican lead. No valid Nevada presidential general-election poll from the last 45 days was present in the provided results, so the source list reflects the Senate contest only.
